items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) ((Polynomial.monomial n) r) = (Polynomial.monomial (n - k)) (↑(n.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: MvPolynomial.mkDerivation_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (R : Type u_2) {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]
  [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] [inst_4 : IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial σ R) A] (f : σ → A) (s : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.mkDerivation R f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) r) =
    r • s.sum fun i k => (MvPolynomial.monomial (s - Finsupp.single i 1)) ↑k • f i

items.name: Polynomial.derivative
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: MvPolynomial.mkDerivation
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  (R : Type u_2) →
    {A : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] →
          [inst_2 : Module R A] →
            [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] →
              [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial σ R) A] → (σ → A) → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {i : σ},
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (s - Finsupp.single i 1)) (a * ↑(s i))
